summary: draventis is a scheduled DAST orchestrator for Kubernetes: a small Python CLI runs OWASP ZAP (Automation Framework) and Nuclei against already-deployed targets and reimports the reports into DefectDojo over its REST API. It ships as a generic Helm chart (CronJob per schedule) and a container image bundling the scanners; the DefectDojo client is stdlib urllib and failure-isolated.

model.purpose: Typed, dependency-free config dataclasses and enums (the in-memory shape of targets.yaml).

config.purpose: Load & validate targets.yaml (or JSON) into a Config; apply defaults; reject dupes/missing fields.

zap.purpose: Pick the ZAP AF plan for a policy, export ${DRAVENTIS_*} env, build & run zap.sh, return the report path. Runner is injectable for tests.

nuclei.purpose: Build & run the nuclei command (JSONL output; -dast for non-baseline targets). Runner injectable.

defectdojo.purpose: reimport-scan client: build multipart/form-data, POST via urllib, never raise (failure-isolated).

cli.purpose: The `draventis run` CLI: parse args, select targets by name/schedule, orchestrate scan + upload with per-target failure isolation.

chart.purpose: Generic Helm chart: renders targets.yaml into a ConfigMap, provisions a plain Secret or ExternalSecret, and creates a CronJob per enabled schedule.

automation.purpose: ZAP Automation Framework plans, one per policy; each ends in a report job writing DefectDojo-ingestible XML.

callgraph_highlights.note: Entry: parse args, refuse without --all/--target/--schedule, load config, dispatch.
Filter targets by name/schedule; per-target try/except isolates failures; returns exit code.
Run ZAP (always) + Nuclei (if enabled); upload each report.
Skips silently if sink disabled (no url) or token empty; never fatal.
The deployed entrypoint; mounts the ConfigMap targets.yaml, envFrom the secret.
